I was ghosted by someone I loved in 2023, and honestly, I nearly lost my mind.

The craziest part was that he didn’t block me . He just stopped talking to me.I would call him up to 100 times a day, and he wouldn’t pick up. I sent countless messages until my thumb started hurting. I called him with different phone numbers, hoping he would answer, but nothing.i was literally dying inside. I became a shadow of myself. I started talking to myself, stopped eating properly, and even my performance at work began to suffer. Sometimes, I would trek all the way home just because I needed time to think, replay everything in my head and try to understand what had happened.

It was one of the darkest periods of my life. I couldn’t understand how someone I loved so deeply could just disappear without a single explanation.
